Social skills that leave
a lasting impression
Making people feel like the only person in the room. Eyes on them, phone away, no looking over their shoulder for someone better. People never forget that feeling.
Asking the second question. Everyone asks "Where are you from?" Few ask "What do you miss most about it?" The follow-up is where real connection starts.
Being genuinely happy for others. When a friend shares good news, celebrate it fully before saying anything about yourself. Generous joy is unforgettable.
Telling short stories well. Get to the point, make it vivid, end with a laugh. People remember the guy who made them laugh at dinner for years after.
Keeping secrets. When someone trusts you with something, it stays with you. Being known as someone safe to talk to builds a reputation that lasts a lifetime.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A man with interesting things to share leaves an impression people carry home with them.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Share interesting things and people carry them home.

slides.texte_overlay: Following through on what you say. "I'll send you that book" means you send it this week. Small promises kept turn first meetings into lasting friendships.
